mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.post_title AS postTitle, p.post_content AS postContent, p.written_datetime AS writtenDatetime, p.modified_datetime AS modifiedDatetime, p.is_opened AS isOpened, p.user_id AS userId, p.trip_id AS tripId, p.clip_id AS clipId, u.user_name AS userName, f.file_url AS profileImageUrl, t.trip_title AS tripTitle, t.trip_party AS tripParty, t.trip_start_date AS tripStartDate, t.trip_end_date AS tripEndDate, ( SELECT file_url FROM file f2 WHERE f2.post_id = p.post_id ORDER BY f2.post_image_order ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN file f ON u.profile_id = f.file_id LEFT JOIN trip t ON p.trip_id = t.trip_id WHERE p.is_opened = true

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.post_title AS postTitle, p.post_content AS postContent, p.written_datetime AS writtenDatetime, p.modified_datetime AS modifiedDatetime, p.is_opened AS isOpened, p.user_id AS userId, p.trip_id AS tripId, p.clip_id AS clipId, u.user_name AS userName, f.file_url AS profileImageUrl, t.trip_title AS tripTitle, t.trip_party AS tripParty, t.trip_start_date AS tripStartDate, t.trip_end_date AS tripEndDate, ( SELECT file_url FROM file f2 WHERE f2.post_id = p.post_id ORDER BY f2.post_image_order ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN file f ON u.profile_id = f.file_id LEFT JOIN trip t ON p.trip_id = t.trip_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.post_title AS postTitle, p.post_content AS postContent, p.written_datetime AS writtenDatetime, p.modified_datetime AS modifiedDatetime, p.is_opened AS isOpened, p.user_id AS userId, p.trip_id AS tripId, p.clip_id AS clipId, u.user_name AS userName, f.file_url AS profileImageUrl, t.trip_title AS tripTitle, t.trip_party AS tripParty, t.trip_start_date AS tripStartDate, t.trip_end_date AS tripEndDate FROM post p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN file f ON u.profile_id = f.file_id LEFT JOIN trip t ON p.trip_id = t.trip_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}

SELECT pl.place_id AS placeId, pl.location_name AS locationName, pl.address AS address, pl.lat AS lat, pl.lng AS lng, pl.open_data AS openData, pl.departure_time AS departureTime, pl.arrival_time AS arrivalTime, pl.idx AS idx, pl.photo_url AS photoUrl, pl.plan_day AS planDay, pl.phone_number AS phoneNumber FROM place pl WHERE pl.trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY pl.idx ASC

SELECT fi.file_id AS fileId, fi.file_url AS fileUrl, fi.post_id AS postId, fi.post_place_id AS postPlaceId, fi.post_image_order AS postImageOrder FROM file fi WHERE fi.post_place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY fi.post_image_order ASC
